name: Northwest Ridge
descent_text: Reverse the ridge on the boot path, taking care with the loose rock on the final scramble and the one short Class 3 gully crossing near the top. Back on the PCT, turn south and drop down the Mirror Lake trail past Cottonwood Lake to the trailhead, about 6 miles round trip for the day.
approach: Start at the Mirror Lake trailhead at the end of Forest Road 5480, a short drive from I-90 exit 62, at about 3,600 ft. Hike the Mirror Lake trail about 1 mile to the Cottonwood Lake spur, then roughly 0.6 mile more to the Pacific Crest Trail. Turn north on the PCT for about 0.6 mile to the point where a boot path leaves the trail on the left and climbs toward the peak's northwest ridge.
